title: aperiodic-nuclear-quartet-category
description: The codomain generated by commutating: the category whose objects are commutative nuclear squares (A, sigma, Delta) over settled fiber Heyting algebras, each carrying the four-corner KZ diamond at one grade of the non-stabilizing aperiodic orbit.

carrier.description: A, the settled fiber Heyting algebra serving as the free carrier of the square

pastNucleus.description: sigma, the past history-nucleus on A

futureNucleus.description: Delta, the future history-nucleus on A

commuting.description: sigma . Delta = Delta . sigma; the two nuclei commute, making the square commutative

quartet.description: the four canonical sub-algebras (A, Fix(sigma), Fix(Delta), A*) with A* = Fix(sigma) intersect Fix(Delta) form an exhaustive commuting square of inclusions - the KZ diamond

morphisms.description: arrows are Heyting homomorphisms preserving both nuclei sigma and Delta
